selected_findings.evidence: The report freezes chosen_date 2026-07-19, initial_auto_selected_date 2026-10-03, schedule_state 2026 NBA Summer League, qualifying_count 3, FINAL status, and the displayed order 1522600074, 1522600075, 1522600076. The NBA schedule page visibly showed all three listings as FINAL (step 34), and the slate extraction recorded the URL and UTC observation time 2026-09-08T11:26:38.934Z (step 38). The changed 2026-10-03 auto-selection is corroborated by the bare-page DOM and screenshot (steps 8 and 10), so it is the applicable auto-selected date for this run.

The NBA PBP and embedded extraction show home TOR, away DEN, Sharp versus Abogidi, and “Sharp 2' Cutting Layup Shot (2 PTS) (Degenhart 1 AST)” at 09:40 (steps 90 and 114). ESPN independently states “Efe Abogidi vs. Jamarion Sharp (Mark Sears gains possession)” and shows the same first layup and assist (step 103); its box score places Mark Sears and Efe Abogidi with Denver (steps 101 and 107). The report instead sets tip_details.team to “Toronto Raptors.” This contradicts the possession-gaining team, which is DEN; the first basket, type, assist, and free-throw exclusion are otherwise supported.

The report records the recipient as winner in every game: Hunter Sallis for 1522600074, Mark Sears for 1522600075, and Olivier-Maxence Prosper for 1522600076. The NBA events say “Tip To Sallis,” “Tip To Sears,” and “Tip To Prosper” (steps 88, 90, and 116), while ESPN confirms the recipients gain possession (steps 73, 103, and the ESPN observations in the final ledger). Under the required semantics, the acceptable winner is the winning jumper/team or null: Dainja/BKN, Abogidi/DEN, and Hendricks/MEM respectively. The report also assigns Toronto as the 1522600075 tip team instead of DEN. Occurrences: 1522600074 winner Hunter Sallis; 1522600075 winner Mark Sears and team Toronto Raptors; 1522600076 winner Olivier-Maxence Prosper.

The final brief and the validation output report 3 games scored, 0 did not score, and a 3/3 share of 100% (step 135). They classify all three games as tip_winner_team_scored_opening_basket. The required reconciled slate is 2 scored and 1 did not, share 2/3 (66.7%/0.667), with 1522600074 scored, 1522600075 did not score, and 1522600076 scored. Thus the count/share are wrong and 1522600075 is misclassified.

The validation output confirms each wrapper game object has game_details as its sole top-level key and that the supplemental slate, source_ledger, conflict_and_verification_log, and opening_possession_brief are present (step 135 and the final artifact). However, validation also shows every game_details object contains an extra nba_game_id key in addition to the six specified fields. R7 permits game IDs in the ledger/log or wrapper, not inside game_details. This is a schema violation for all three game objects.

The ledger records chosen_date 2026-07-19, auto_selected_date 2026-10-03, observation_utc 2026-09-08T11:35:26.464Z, qualifying_count 3, three FINAL statuses, zero unfinished listings, and order 1522600074, 1522600075, 1522600076. These are corroborated by steps 26, 42, 48, 50, and 156, with the run-specific auto-date supported by step 26. However, the deliverable never explicitly freezes a schedule-state description such as “2026 NBA Summer League” or “off-season”; the source identifier espn_summer_league_scoreboard is not an explicit schedule-state field.

The final object reports TOR home and DEN away, Jamarion Sharp and Efe Abogidi as jumpers, DEN as the possession-gaining tip team, both jumpers in players_involved, and Sharp’s TOR Cutting Layup Shot assisted by Tyson Degenhart. Step 87 extracts “Sharp 2' Cutting Layup Shot (2 PTS) (Degenhart 1 AST)” as the first NBA Made Shot; step 109 independently reports the Jamarion Sharp layup and Degenhart assist. The Sears free throw is not substituted as the first basket.

The reported winners are Dain Dainja/BKN, Efe Abogidi/DEN, and Taylor Hendricks/MEM, while the possession recipients are Sallis, Sears, and Prosper. Step 87 supplies the NBA jump-ball sequences and step 113 supplies the ESPN recipient/team observations; the final objects use the winning jumper rather than the recipient and use the recipient’s team as tip_details.team. These conform to the permitted winner semantics.

The final brief reports 2 games where the tip winner’s team scored, 1 where it did not, and a 2/3 share with 66.67 percent. Step 168 corroborates the counts, numerator, denominator, decimal share, and displayed order; the per-game classifications match the extracted events in step 87: 0074 scored, 0075 did not, and 0076 scored.

Each final per-game wrapper has game_details as its sole top-level key, and the ledger, conflict/verification log, and opening-possession brief are present. However, every game_details object contains an unsupported extra game_id field in addition to the six specified fields. Occurrences: 1522600074, 1522600075, and 1522600076 in the final result and artifact. Step 161’s validation explicitly confirms the objects contain game_id plus the specified fields.

final_schema_check.code: const fs=require('node:fs'); const finalText=fs.readFileSync(finalPath,'utf8'); const parsed=JSON.parse(finalText); const checks={exists:fs.existsSync(finalPath),games:parsed.games.length,soleGameKeys:parsed.games.map(g=>Object.keys(g)),gameDetailKeys:parsed.games.map(g=>Object.keys(g.game_details)),tipKeys:parsed.games.map(g=>Object.keys(g.game_details.tip_details)),basketKeys:parsed.games.map(g=>Object.keys(g.game_details.first_basket_details)),allFinal:parsed.slate.displayed_order.every(x=>x.displayed_status==='FINAL'),idsMatch:parsed.games.map(g=>g.game_details.nba_game_id).join(',')===parsed.slate.displayed_order.map(x=>x.nba_game_id).join(','),countMatches:parsed.slate.qualifying_count===parsed.games.length&&parsed.opening_possession_brief.final_slate_count===parsed.games.length,counts: [parsed.opening_possession_brief.tip_winner_team_scored_opening_basket_count,parsed.opening_possession_brief.tip_winner_team_did_not_score_opening_basket_count,parsed.opening_possession_brief.calculable_share]}; console.log(JSON.stringify(checks,null,2));
final_schema_check.note: Prints keys without asserting the exact allowed key set. Both candidate and reference include an extra game ID inside game_details.

scope: Offline re-derivation from original saved NBA player rosters and opening events, corroborated by original ESPN excerpts. No live replay or rescore.
generalized_findings: A source actor, recipient and team are separate roles. Field names and nearby values do not establish a semantic mapping.
Verify raw-to-canonical mappings and join keys before testing downstream calculations. A correct equality function can classify incorrectly constructed records.
All three candidate winner fields name recipients rather than one of the two jumpers. The Denver game also assigns that recipient to the wrong team, producing the wrong aggregate.
Neither arm compacts. This failure cannot be attributed to compaction. The task/game-specific audit code is not added to the SDK.
